info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Webhook Subscriptions API
info.description: The Manage Webhook Subscriptions API offers businesses the ability to manage and remove specific webhook notifications. By providing the unique webhook ID, users can effectively unsubscribe from unnecessary notifications, enhancing their system's efficiency and relevance. This functionality is crucial for developers and system administrators who need to maintain an optimal flow of data and respond to only pertinent updates. Typical use cases include refining event-driven architectures and managing notification preferences for various applications.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a webhook identified by its unique resource ID. Use this operation to ensure that the webhook is no longer receiving events.

requestBody.description: The request body for the deletion of the specified webhook. It contains necessary information to identify the webhook to be removed from the system.

DeleteWebhookRes100045Request.description: A request body for operations performed through webhooks, specifically for delete actions.

DeleteWebhookRes100045Response_204.description: This schema represents the response for a successful DELETE operation, returning a status indication in string format.

x-endpoint-id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that handles the webhook event.

x-runtime-app.description: The name of the runtime application that processed the webhook event.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. Clients must include a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header to access protected resources.
